metadata.title: Micron Stock:  China Is Grabbing Memory Market Share, and Shares Are Falling<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
China Is Grabbing Memory Market Share. This Stock Could Be a Big Loser.
The memory-chip race is getting fiercer by the day. Micron Technology looks to be holding its own against the growing presence of Chinese suppliers but it’s a trickier time for SK Hynix.
